Yes, student S2025CS017 (Riya Shah) is eligible for a merit fee concession because her CGPA is 8.6, which falls in the 8.50 – 8.99 slab [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2 Merit concession slabs], and she has no overdue entries in the fee ledger [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §3 Eligibility conditions]. 

The concession amount is 15% of the annual tuition [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2 Merit concession slabs]. Based on the annual tuition amount of ₹1,45,000 for the CS department year 2 [SQL], the concession is:
* 15% × ₹1,45,000 = ₹21,750

As per the policy, this concession is credited against the next academic year's tuition and is split proportionally across the two instalments [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §4 Calculation and application].
sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, s.year_of_study, fs.component AS fee_component, fs.amount AS annual_tuition_amount, fl.component AS ledger_component, fl.amount_due, fl.amount_paid, (fl.amount_due - fl.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, fl.status FROM students AS s JOIN departments AS d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN fee_structure AS fs ON fs.dept_id = s.dept_id AND fs.year_of_study = s.year_of_study AND fs.academic_year = '2026-27' AND fs.component = 'tuition' LEFT JOIN fee_ledger AS fl ON fl.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2025CS017' AND d.code = 'CS' LIMIT 200
